QuestInfo.name: The Right to Own a Home
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p425# of #m10003007# has an exciting offer for me.
QuestInfo.1: #p425# of #m10003007# said in an excited voice that she had good news, and told me I'd been granted the right to own a house in this town. To hear more details, I should go find #b#p426##k.
QuestInfo.2: #p426# of #m10003007# gruffly told me all about houses.

0.0: #h0#! I was just looking for you~ I've got some really great news for you. Wanna hear it?

yes.0: Awesome! We all know how much effort you've put into #m10003000#, so we've decided to grant you the right to own a house. Isn't that exciting?
yes.1: You look like you've got a ton of questions, like how to get a house and what perks come with one! Ehehe. In that case, go meet #b#p426##k here first. He can tell you all the details. Congratulations again!

no.0: Huh? I didn't expect you to say no!

1.0: So you're #h0#. #p425# told me plenty about you. I'm getting some places ready for the folks who've just become residents of #m10003000#, and it looks like you're the lucky one.
1.1: What can you do with a house, you ask? Heh, fine. At your own place, you can deck it out with whatever furniture you like, and set up handy stuff like storage and a crafting station. Use #b#t2030010##k and you can head straight home, too. The perks don't stop there.
1.2: On top of that, you can invite people over to your place, or drop by someone else's. Kicking back with your friends in a cozy place of your own, what's better than that?

npc.0: #p426# over here can tell you a lot more about houses.
